comments.text:
Cory, I got you fam

SpringBonnie: easiest to deal with, you’ve handled him well. But when you leave from under a table, don’t use your flashlight, he’ll see it.

SpringFreddy: the one on the stage next to Bonnie. He doesn’t activate unless the power turns off. If that happens, head to the office, and interact with the screen in the back of the office. Then you need to head to the breaker box at the entrance of the building, in the little side room.

FredBear: the sprinter. He’s the one behind the curtain. Keep the curtains closed, or he’ll come for you. If things get really bad, turn the power off and hide. He can see you through the camera system, so no matter where you are, if the power is on, and he comes out, he will know where you are, and he will get you.

Plushtrap: the doll on the desk. If you hide under one table for too long, his programming activates, and, thinking you’re a child being scared, he’ll come to you and sing a song, inadvertently alerting the animatronics to your location. Also, don’t run around the same tables over and over. It’s part of his programming to prevent kids from doing that so they don’t get hurt. (Yes the irony is brazenly clear) So if you go around the same tables again and again, he’ll jumpscare you to get you to stop.

The last night is a real treat, one that I can only minimally prepare you for.

The Thing: if you hear it coming, wait until it is close, then hit it with the flashlight. It’ll melt away. Rinse and repeat.

The ghost kids: do not run into them. They will call the Thing to you, killing you on contact.

The animatronics: they no longer chase you, but stand in hallways to make your progress take longer. Don’t touch them.

Your goal: wait at the computer in the office, the one that controls the power. Wait until the timer winds down until you can head to the breaker I mentioned earlier, then flip the switch. Rinse and repeat until 6 am.

Like so Cory can see.

comments.text:
Alright Mr. Ankle Breaker lemme break it down for you

Plushtrap is the ANTICHEESE system. He is there to make sure you don’t hide the entire game or try to cheese the animatronics like how you ran around the table. Any cheese you can think of, he will thwart you.

Spring Bonnie and Golden Freddy are the main guys on stage they’re easy enough just stay out of their way and manage your stamina. When the music plays and light flashes that’s Golden Freddy activating. He will also shut off your power. Nothing to do with Fredbear.

Big Boy Fredbear is BEHIND THE CURTAINS. Keep the curtain closed and he won’t come out. The curtains open up faster each night and as the game says his eyes are linked to the camera. If the power is on and he gets out…GGs. If the power is out, he comes straight to the security room then he will roam until he spots you. I don’t know if he ever goes back behind the curtains or what happens if you turn on the power while he is out. 

If the power runs out or you shut it down, there will be a 30 second cooldown on the computer screen you use to emergency shutdown. Hit the button after the countdown is up and hit the breaker behind the stage and boom the power is back on.

comments.text: This is probably the best fnaf fan game, or even just fnaf game in general to come out in a while. Even though it’s free roam, it feels like it’s bringing the franchise back to its roots. What made the OG fnaf so scary was its atmosphere and that sense of hopelessness whenever you encountered an animatronic. Just when you think you have all of them figured out, suddenly one of them starts sprinting at you out of nowhere. And when you think you have him handled, a golden bear suddenly teleports in front of your desk and crashes your game. That existential dread of realizing you never had it figured out in the first place is replicated perfectly with fredbear because he’s so radically different from the slow moving bonny, who makes the game seem way easier than it actually is. And the atmosphere when you need to shut off the power… kudos to nixxon, they cooked up something special.
